disclaimer.specialGroupsBody: ⚠️ Intermittent fasting is not recommended for the following groups, or should only be done under medical supervision: pregnant or breastfeeding women; minors (under 18); people with a history of or at risk for eating disorders (e.g., anorexia, bulimia); people with diabetes (especially those using insulin or glucose-lowering medication); people with hypoglycemia or hypotension; people who are underweight (BMI < 18.5); people with chronic conditions such as gout, kidney or liver disease; people recovering from recent surgery or illness; and frail older adults. If you fall into any of these categories, do not start a fasting plan and consult your doctor first.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.body:
Effective: 2026-07-27 | Version 1.0.0 [Pending external confirmation: final legal copy]

EatWise ("we") provides services in mainland China only. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information, and the rights you have.

1. Information We Collect
1) Phone number: for registration, sign-in, and account recovery; stored encrypted in mainland China.
2) Height, weight, age, gender: used to compute daily nutrition targets; sensitive personal information requiring your separate consent.
3) Meal and fasting records: required for core features; sensitive personal information.
4) Goal, schedule, and fasting experience (3-question quiz): used for plan recommendation.
5) Nickname and avatar: optional, for personalization and community display.
6) Device info and push token: for notification delivery and crash analysis; we never collect IMEI/IMSI/MAC.
7) Crash and performance logs: de-identified, retained for 6 months.
8) Analytics events: event-level usage stats only; can be turned off in Settings > Privacy.
We do NOT collect: location, contacts, Bluetooth, or HealthKit/Health Connect data.

2. Separate Consent for Sensitive Personal Information
Health-related data (height/weight, meal/fasting records) is processed only with your separate consent under PIPL Article 29. Declining does not affect account features — nutrition targets fall back to defaults — and you may withdraw anytime in Settings > Privacy.

3. Storage and Security
All data is stored on servers in mainland China; transmission uses TLS 1.2+; phone numbers and health data use field-level encryption; the local database is fully encrypted. No data crosses borders.

4. Third-Party SDKs
We use WeChat Login, Sign in with Apple, aggregated push, content safety, and crash monitoring SDKs, all operating within mainland China. No SDK ever receives your raw health data.

5. Your Rights
1) Access & copy: request a full export of your personal data (JSON+CSV) in Settings > Privacy > Export my data.
2) Deletion: Settings > Account > Delete account starts a 7-day cooling-off period; signing in during this period cancels the deletion.
3) Withdraw consent: you may withdraw health data consent and analytics consent anytime in Settings > Privacy.

6. Minors
This product is not intended for children under 14.

7. Policy Updates
If this policy changes materially, we will ask for your consent again.

8. Contact Us
For questions about this policy, reach us via Settings > About in the app.

userAgreement.title: Terms of Service
userAgreement.body:
Effective: 2026-07-27 | Version 1.0.0 [Pending external confirmation: final legal copy]

Welcome to EatWise (the "App"). Please read these terms carefully before using the App.

1. Services
The App provides healthy-lifestyle tools including intermittent fasting timers, meal logging, nutrition target estimates with signal-light feedback, trend reports, and community check-ins.

2. Account
You may register and sign in via phone verification code, WeChat, or Sign in with Apple. Keep your account secure; you are responsible for activity under it.

3. Not Medical Advice
All content in the App is general healthy-lifestyle reference only and is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. See the Disclaimer for details.

4. User Conduct
You agree that content you post complies with applicable laws and does not infringe others' rights. Violating content may be removed and account features restricted.

5. Intellectual Property
The App's content and software are owned by us; you receive a personal, non-commercial license to use them.

6. Limitation of Liability
We assume no medical liability for health consequences arising from use of the App's information, and no liability for service interruptions caused by force majeure or third parties.

7. Changes and Termination
We will notify you of changes to these terms via in-app notices. You may stop using the App at any time by deleting your account.

8. Governing Law
These terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.
